claims.text: G2 lists four Plane pricing editions ranging from $0 to $499. (price check unavailable) (source text unavailable, not judged)
Plane offers a free tier supporting up to 12 users at $0 per month.
The Pro plan for Plane costs $6 per seat per month.
FindPM lists a Pro plan for Plane at $8 per member per month.
Plane's Business plan is priced at $13 per seat per month.
FindPM lists a Business plan for Plane at custom pricing.
Plane provides an Enterprise Grid plan with custom pricing for organizations needing private or managed deployments.
Annual billing offers a 25% discount on Plane's Pro plan and a 13% discount on its Business plan.
A cost comparison on Plane's pricing page indicates a 10-person team would pay roughly $720 per year for Plane compared with about $2,084 for Jira and Confluence combined.
A 10-user deployment of Plane on cloud or self-hosted costs $2,160 over three years at $6 per seat per month with yearly billing.
Plane operates as an AI-first platform unifying tasks, documents, workflows, and AI assistance.
Plane includes an AI assistant that lets users ask natural-language questions about project progress, blockers, deadlines, and work items.
The platform provides a built-in wiki and documentation pages linked to work items.
Plane supports time tracking at the work item level, and the feature is included in the Pro tier.
Plane supports SAML and LDAP single sign-on across workspaces.
SAML-based single sign-on requires Plane's Business plan at $13 per seat per month.
The tool offers migration support for moving from Jira, Asana, Trello, Linear, ClickUp, and Confluence.
Plane integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Discord, and other third-party tools.
Plane can be self-hosted via Docker or Kubernetes, including air-gapped enterprise environments.
A Prime CLI feature enables single-command installation, configuration, backup, and monitoring for self-hosted instances.
Plane holds SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance certifications.
Version 1.4.0 introduced lightweight REST API endpoints for list views alongside improved webhooks and a modular translation architecture.
Jira is a widely used project management and issue tracking platform developed by Atlassian.
Atlassian discontinued support for Jira Server in February 2024 and plans to end Jira Data Center by March 2029 while shifting focus to Atlassian Cloud.
Jira Cloud Standard plan pricing starts at approximately $7 to $8 per user per month, and Premium starts at roughly $14 to $16 per user per month, with custom Enterprise pricing.
Jira Data Center pricing starts at $51,000 per year for teams of 500 or more.
ClickUp offers paid project management plans ranging from about $7 to $12 per user per month, plus a custom-priced Enterprise tier.
ClickUp sells separate AI add-ons including ClickUp Brain at $9 per user per month when billed annually.
Shortcut offers a Team plan at $10 per user per month and a Business plan at $16 per user per month, with discounts up to 25% for annual payment.
Shortcut receives user criticism for limited reporting depth, lack of a mobile app, and steep per-user pricing for small teams.
Pivotal Tracker shut down on April 30, 2025.
Some users consider alternatives to Plane because self-hosting demands technical upkeep and its advanced reporting is less mature than Jira's. (source text unavailable, not judged)
Augment Code notes that Plane's interface feels less polished than Linear's and that its community is smaller than those of Jira, Linear, or Shortcut.
Plane is positioned as an open-source alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp.
Among compared tools, Plane is the only option that supports self-hosting with an open-source codebase.
VentureGaps gives Plane an overall rating of 7.5 out of 10. (source text unavailable, not judged)
FindPM shows an average user rating of 4.7 out of 5 for Plane based on three reviews.
PeerSpot states that Plane surpasses competitors through intuitive collaboration, seamless integration capabilities, and robust security.
Plane includes customizable workflows, cycles, modules, dependencies, and multiple views such as board, list, calendar, Gantt, and spreadsheet. (judge: not_stated)
